proposal.reason: Main change is in GIN networking behavior: GDAKI and GIN_IB_PROXY now add LAG-aware QP TX-port affinity selection/capability gating and per-context/per-peer rotation to balance GIN P2P traffic, plus related proxy depth-handling behavior. The mlx5/DOCA symbol and wrapper edits are supporting plumbing for this same GIN-specific feature, not separate module policy changes.
